title: Investigate moving proof-of-work artifacts out of the git worktree
description: Proof artifacts are currently written to proof-of-work/<task-id>/ inside the worktree and get committed to git. On public projects this leaks terminal recordings (asciinema casts), which can contain secrets, env vars, or internal paths. Investigate a new setup that stores proof-of-work outside the repo worktree (e.g. a per-host external dir, ~/.local/state, a store keyed by task id, or a separate artifact repo). Deliverables: survey current writers (belayd-proof-generator prompt, quality-gates gateProofContent, any docs referencing proof-of-work/), identify all consumers of those paths, and propose a concrete relocation design including gitignore/hook implications and how the quality gate validates artifacts at their new location.

dependencies.title: fix(proof): align gateProofContent artifact refs with the proof-generator contract
Implement proof-of-work relocation out of the git worktree
